content: Multi-head attention, as introduced in BIBREF3 , computes multiple identical attention mechanism parallelly on multiple linear projections of same inputs. The parameters of each attention and projections are different in each head. Finally, they concatenate all the attentions which is similar to how we concatenate conflict and attention. However, they use dot-product to compute each of the attention.
